question_text:
The members of a distinguished committee were choosing a president, and each member gave one vote to one of the 27 candidates.  For each candidate, the exact percentage of votes the candidate got was smaller by at least 1 than the number of votes for that candidate. What is the smallest possible number of members of the committee?

Return only the final boxed answer content as a concise mathematical expression.

首先，我需要明确题目的条件。每个候选人得到的票数设为v_i，总共有n个成员，所以总票数是n。对于每个候选人i，他们的得票百分比是(v_i / n) * 100，这个百分比比v_i小至少1。也就是说，对于每个i，有：

(v_i / n) * 100 ≤ v_i - 1

或者等价地：

(v_i / n) * 100 ≤ v_i - 1

100v_i ≤ n(v_i - 1)

展开右边：

100v_i ≤ n v_i - n

将左边移到右边：

0 ≤ n v_i - n - 100v_i

即：

n v_i - n - 100v_i ≥ 0

可以提取v_i：

v_i (n - 100) - n ≥ 0

或者：

v_i (n - 100) ≥ n

这时候需要考虑n的大小。因为如果n - 100是正数的话，那么v_i ≥ n / (n - 100)。但n必须大于100，否则n - 100是负数，这时候不等式方向会改变。所以可能需要分情况讨论。

100 / n ≤ 1 - 1 / v_i

100 / n + 1 / v_i ≤ 1

v_i (1 - 100/n) ≥ 1

v_i ≥ 1 / (1 - 100/n)

v_i ≥ 1 / (1 - 100/n) = n / (n - 100)
